title: Fix review findings on the Remote agent CLI install
body:
Fix the review findings on "install a missing agent CLI on a Remote" (commit 505571f: src/remote.rs, src/remote_install.rs, src/remote_probe.rs, src/remotes_pane.rs, src/launcher.rs, src/icons.rs, src/terminal.rs, src/wm.rs). A code review and a design review each refused sign-off. No new features beyond what is listed.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (the install part of the UI section). Feature doc: docs/remote-sessions.md.
Blocked by: Install a missing agent CLI on a Remote from the UI
Must fix (code):
1. An install Session is treated as an agent everywhere except remote::relaunch. remote::install_of is checked only inside relaunch; remote::agent_of and icons::IconKind::from_argv still substring-scan the install argv, and the Claude and Codex install URLs contain the provider name. So the install tab gets the agent icon, the agent badge, status "agent", auto_agent_title, the hook source checks, and workspace save writes it as that agent: after a restart Enter on that tab resumes the agent. Grok's URL has no "grok", so it behaves differently again. Make agent_of and IconKind::from_argv return None when install_of(argv) is Some, give install tabs the plain shell icon, and save them as a plain Remote shell. Tests: icon, agent_of and the workspace snapshot for all three providers.
2. The re-Test after an install can be dropped. refresh_installs calls remote_probe::start_test, which does nothing while a Test is already running (TestCache::begin returns false); the in-flight Test was probed before the install and lands "missing". Queue one re-run for when the running Test finishes. Do not re-Test a Remote that no longer exists.
3. wm.rs run_install is the one choke point and re-checks nothing. The launcher prompt confirms a snapshot (Ask.offer): if a Test landed meanwhile saying the agent is there, or an install of that provider on that Remote is already Installing, Enter still starts an installer. In run_install refuse (with a plain toast) when the mark is Installing or the live state is no longer Missing with the gate ready, and use the live Remote's shell, not the snapshot.
4. The install Session leases a Tunnel, so FOREMAN_URL and FOREMAN_TOKEN are exported into a third-party curl-pipe-bash and ExitOnForwardFailure can fail an install over a port clash. Nothing posts from an installer: open install Sessions with no Tunnel.
Must fix (design):
5. A stale "missing" result locks the agent out of the launcher: once a Test this run says missing, the row only offers install or cancel, even if the user installed it by hand since. Add a "launch anyway" button to the launcher prompt (never the Enter default; Enter stays on the safe choice) and a line saying the last Test did not find it and where to Test again (Settings > Remotes).
6. The agents line overflows PANE_MIN_W on the feature's main sequence: "claude installed, needs login - codex installed, needs login - [install grok]" is wider than the pane, so the third button is clipped. Group like states the way needs/by_hand already are ("claude, codex installed, need login") and add that combination, and three installed, to the existing fit test.
Also fix (small):
- A failed or cancelled install looks the same as never tried; say so in text on the row ("grok install did not finish") with the install action still offered.
- The pane confirm hides which Project the Session opens in and "login needed after" behind hover; show them on the footer line while the confirm is open, and refuse BEFORE the confirm when no Project is open instead of after.
- Label PowerShell install commands as untested on Windows Remotes in the confirm note.
- Mark::Ended never clears, so "installed, needs login" sticks for the whole run even after the user logged in; clear it when an agent Session for that provider opens on that Remote.
- The pane confirm sets max_rows = 2 and the test checks only height: assert no INSTALL command is elided at PANE_MIN_W, and never truncate the Remote's name out of the question.
- agents_line and states_from allocate and clone under a mutex per Remote every frame; cache by the Test entry generation and mark.
- docs/remote-sessions.md: note that install Sessions carry no Tunnel and are saved as a plain shell, only if the code does not already say it.
Do NOT run any installer against the test Remote.
Done when:
- unit tests for each must-fix above (icon/agent_of/snapshot for the three providers; queued re-Test; run_install refusals; no Tunnel in the install launch; "launch anyway" in the prompt model and not the default; the fit test with the grouped states)
- the launcher model with no Remotes and with a never-tested Remote is unchanged
- the full test suite passes
- the final report lists the states the human should capture with build-screenshot
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent
